target.statement: Mean ARI of 0.2442 for ShapeDBA (k-means with ShapeDBA averaging and ShapeDTW similarity) across 123 UCR datasets

compute.basis: The target is an average over 123 UCR datasets, each requiring k-means with ShapeDBA (5 initializations) plus all baselines; the paper reports total runtime of ~23,000 seconds for ShapeDBA alone on their machine, so reproducing the full mean ARI on a laptop would take many hours, though a single dataset cell would be much cheaper.

blockers: Target is an aggregate over 123 datasets, not a single cheap cell; full reproduction requires running all clustering variants on all datasets
Code repository may not include exact configs/scripts to reproduce the reported mean ARI
Quadratic time complexity of DTW/ShapeDTW makes some UCR datasets slow on CPU
title: ShapeDBA: Generating Effective Time Series Prototypes using ShapeDTW Barycenter Averaging
